manifest.notes: Not Firm (NOTSTOCK) on Robinhood Chain, paired with IMD. LaunchToken (src/LaunchToken.sol) is the fixed-supply ERC-20 with no owner, mint, fee, pause or upgrade. Three application contracts deploy in the launch transaction, in constructor dependency order. LpDesk(token, operator, projectWallet): token is $token; operator is the dev wallet SPEC.md fixes, 0x8ad18e99f4c8d8406f9ba8899cf308000518a981, which sets slippage outs by hand, runs buyback and holds the 2-day governance veto; projectWallet is the project wallet SPEC.md fixes, 0x3c587eff6c96eacf7e3dcc2cff6416161386e48c (written as a literal, not $owner, so it is pinned whatever owner the launch resolves; it is a payee with no owner role), which receives 25% of every non-NOTSTOCK fee. LpDesk's constructor creates Burner (not a manifest contract) and only predicts the CREATE2 addresses of its modules; after launch anyone calls deployModule(kind, code) once per kind (LpGovernor, PriceGuard, VenueV3, VenueV4, script/DeployModules.s.sol), so the modules are not manifest contracts either. FirmVault(projectWallet, lpDesk): the same project wallet literal and $contract:LpDesk; it receives the pool's 1% requester fee once the project wallet calls the factory's setRequester(launchNumber, FirmVault) after launch, and distribute(token) by anyone splits IMD 25/25/25/25 and sends NOTSTOCK to Burner. GenesisSplitter(lpDesk, devWallet): $contract:LpDesk and the same dev wallet; split() by anyone, once, sends 10/60 of its balance to the dev wallet and the rest to LpDesk after registerNotStock. No contract is allocated supply at launch: the factory mints the whole supply to itself, seeds the pool with 30%, sends 10% to the MerkleDistributor and 60% to the owner, who then transfers exactly 600,000,000 NOTSTOCK to GenesisSplitter by hand. No privileged role is given to the factory or to IMD's launch wallet; no initialization calls. The pool fields are the launch policy's: pairedCurrency IMD, fee 12500 (1.25%), tickSpacing 60; the deployer derives the opening price from the policy's 2,500 IMD opening market cap. The factory supplies the pool guard and the MerkleDistributor.
